description: This file declares the SetPlaybackRate class, which is a task for setting the playback rate in a media player context. It includes necessary headers, defines the class with its constructor, destructor, and execute method, and contains private members for context, wrappers, and rate.

classes.name: SetPlaybackRate

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
